stack: PHP 8.2 (image wallabag38-php = docker/php upstream target 'default') + SQLite file + Redis (sessions) — SSR Symfony/Twig + Materialize 1.x + Stimulus ; build assets = yarn/webpack encore

boot.clone: git clone https://github.com/wallabag/wallabag target && git checkout 496db5b457755bbf7d46f314716c8aad1b80fcfb
boot.override: cp tools/compose.override.yaml . && mkdir -p .bench && cp tools/serve-router.php .bench/ — l'override gitignored force APP_ENV=prod + php -S 0.0.0.0:8000 -t web /opt/serve-router.php (le serveur amont sert --env=dev ; le bench cible le produit livré). cp docker/php/env.example docker/php/env
boot.up: PORT=8038 docker compose -p wallabag38 up -d [--build]  (si Docker Hub rate-limit : docker tag <image déjà buildée> <projet>-php)
boot.deps: docker exec <projet>-php-1 sh -c 'cd /var/www/html && composer install --no-interaction --prefer-dist && yarn install --frozen-lockfile && yarn build:prod' — vendor/ et web/build/ sont gitignored : hors patch, toujours rebuilder
boot.install: docker exec <projet>-php-1 php bin/console wallabag:install --env=prod -n — crée le schéma sqlite data/db/wallabag.sqlite + user admin wallabag/wallabag
boot.seed: docker cp tools/seed.php <projet>-php-1:/tmp/seed.php && docker exec <projet>-php-1 php /tmp/seed.php — idempotent : 14 entrées HTML réelles (9 unread, 5 archived, 4 starred, 2 annotées, 2 untagged), 14 tags, 7 tagging-rules, config items_per_page=30 lang=en ; entry#1 public share uid 0af38edc9ca4c9157176453
boot.login: node tools/login.mjs http://127.0.0.1:8038 wallabag wallabag auth.json — storageState cookies

urls: tools/urls-auth.txt — 25 pages auth (listes unread/starred/archive/annotated/all/untagged, tags, config, import+2 sous-pages, new, view×2, edit, search résultats, users list/new, settings, howto, about, quickstart, developer, domain, ignore-origin-instance-rules) + tools/urls-public.txt (/login + /share/<uid>)
states: voir states.json — 11 états : account-dropdown, search-panel, add-url-panel, export-sidenav, filters-sidenav, mass-action-bar, config-tab-rules, entry-annotated, entry-leftbar-theme, dark-theme, mobile-nav-390 — triggers dispatchEvent('click') (Materialize capte mousedown), sélecteurs déterministes + stateProof (leçon 32)
axe: 4.14.0 (tools/package.json épinglé — axeVersion reporté dans scope.json + report.json)

auditCommands.baseline_auth: node tools/audit.mjs http://127.0.0.1:8038 --urls "$(cat tools/urls-auth.txt | tr '\n' ',')" --states all --storage-state auth.json --wait 1000 --out reports/baseline/auth
auditCommands.baseline_public: node tools/audit.mjs http://127.0.0.1:8038 --urls "$(cat tools/urls-public.txt | tr '\n' ',')" --states none --wait 1000 --out reports/baseline/public
auditCommands.final_auth: idem baseline_auth → reports/final/auth (produit patché, rebuild yarn build:prod + cache:clear --env=prod)
auditCommands.verify: node tools/verify.mjs http://127.0.0.1:8038 auth.json — 29 assertions DOM indépendantes du score axe
auditCommands.probes: node tools/incomplete-probes.mjs <base> <report.json> <out.json> [auth.json] — mesure pixel-vraie des incomplets (leçon 31)
auditCommands.eval_final: node tools/eval-final.mjs http://127.0.0.1:8038 auth.json — 16 pages hors périmètre + 404 + replays à froid + public /resetting/request /login
auditCommands.install_build: clone propre → git apply patch.diff → boot identique sur PORT=8039 projet wallabag38ib → seed+login auth-ib.json → rescan verbatim → reports/install-build/{auth,public}
